notes: This contract pins the official C++ surfaces used by the bounded changed-lookahead timestamped regional-interaction re-enable slice. A producer queues one overlap-qualified Send Interaction With Regions while regulating with lookahead one, moves the live source region out of overlap, disables regulation, re-enables it with lookahead three, verifies Query Lookahead, and advances to release the queued Receive Interaction before the constrained recipient's grant. The queued source-region snapshot, callback metadata, and retraction classification are preserved. This is development-profile evidence only; it does not claim relaxed DDM, alternate advances, save/restore, remote transport, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, validation, interoperability, or conformance.
